message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce post-launch exposure and place the southbound Team B missiles off its nose by completing a hard right, descending turn into sustained eastbound separation, while its previously launched missile continues north and the opposing formation remains ahead.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks initially to preserve offensive pressure by accelerating and descending northward behind its previously launched missile as the formations close, but late in the window it begins a hard right turn, consistent with seeking lateral separation from the approaching southbound missiles rather than continuing head-on."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce post-launch exposure and place the southbound Team B missiles off its nose by completing a hard right, descending turn into sustained eastbound separation, while its previously launched missile continues north and the opposing formation remains ahead.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks initially to preserve offensive pressure by accelerating and descending northward behind its previously launched missile as the formations close, but late in the window it begins a hard right turn, consistent with seeking lateral separation from the approaching southbound missiles rather than continuing head-on.
